diagnosis.actualEvidence: Shift+RMB cursor events arrived together; KK_MOVE records an accepted terrain command, but no Walk state was observed over the next three seconds. The click was not dropped or rejected for terrain.
diagnosis.sourceDefect: MoveAtCursor samples IsInputKeyDown(Shift) during delayed delegate processing. Press and release can be collected in the same frame, clearing that final key state before the delegate executes.
diagnosis.preparedCorrection: Capture event-time platform Shift state and cursor for each RMB press/double-click, consume contexts FIFO through the existing IE_Pressed binding, clear unused contexts after input processing and on FlushPressedKeys. Add press/dispatch/terrain rejection logs.
diagnosis.preparedTests: Keep ordinary 60ms taps, observe the camera after F8/Home, then test immediate unmodified, Right Shift and Left Shift down/up gestures.
